name: InterContinental Ljubljana
positioning: Glass-fronted high-rise in the centre of Slovenia's capital, with a rooftop restaurant and bar, an 18th-floor pool and gym, and views to the castle and the Alps
best_for: City travelers who want a central base close to Ljubljana Castle, the Triple Bridge and the old town
Guests who want high-floor views, an indoor pool and a spa in the city

facts.text: The hotel sits in the center of Slovenia's capital, close to Ljubljana Castle, the Triple Bridge and the historic old town.
Tivoli Park and Ljubljana Old Town are each about half a kilometer from the hotel.
Lake Bled is suggested as a day trip from the hotel.
Guests can explore the city on the hotel's custom city tours.
Rooms have a marble bathroom with a soaking tub or walk-in shower.
Junior Suites may include mountain views.
Serenity SPA offers a sauna and steam bathing, along with facials, beauty treatments, manicures and pedicures.
The indoor pool is heated and includes a whirlpool.
After a workout, guests can have a freshly squeezed juice from the gym's vitamin bar.
B-Restaurant and Bar spans the entire 20th floor and includes a restaurant, an outdoor terrace and a bar.
Bloom Lounge, next to the lobby, is filled with plants and serves freshly brewed coffee with croissants or cakes inspired by French cuisine with a local twist.
Dogs staying at the hotel receive a dog pillow, drinking bowl and small toy in the room.

highlights.text: The rooftop restaurant and bar have a 360-degree view over Ljubljana's old town, with the castle on one side and the Alps on the other.
The hotel is the tallest hotel in Ljubljana, with a glass exterior.
The indoor swimming pool is on the 18th floor, with views of Tivoli Park.
The 18th-floor gym has personal trainers and a relaxation space with 360-degree skyline views of Ljubljana.
Rooms and suites feature marble bathrooms and city views.

considerations.text: Hotel parking is off-site with limited capacity, subject to availability.
Dogs up to 12 kg are allowed in guest rooms only.
WhataHotel notes that pricing reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
